'''Ergast's holocron''' was located in the [[Ergast|namesake]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord's]] tomb in the [[Dark Temple]] on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Darth Nox|Kallig]] visited the tomb and accessed the [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]], in order to learn the [[Force walk]]ing ritual.
